title: How to do The Reject Step (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial) | Mihran Kirakosian

method.teacher_system: The teacher demonstrates the move once with music, then breaks down the footwork step-by-step from a mirrored angle. He repeats the sequence slowly, gradually adding counts and momentum before practicing with music at increasing speeds.
method.signature: Explicitly stating that the video has been mirrored for the learner to follow along easily.

practices.what: Demonstrates the reject step once to music from a side profile view.
Breaks down the first part of the movement starting with the left leg jumping back and right leg kicking up.
Repeats the first segment multiple times with verbal counts.
Adds the second part of the movement: taking the right leg back and hopping forward on the left leg.
Connects both parts together using counts 5, 6, 7, 8 and jump 1, 2.
Reviews the entire sequence slowly from the top with continuous counts.
Practices the learned reject step sequence together with music at a slow tempo.
Executes the full step to music at full tempo.

struggles.theme: Trouble keeping balance and staying on one leg
Putting leg back instead of forward and mixing up legs
Gathering momentum on the second step

clicked.theme: Clear step-by-step breakdown made it easy to learn quickly
Turning off the sound helps avoid getting confused by legs

method.limits: The video does not show upper body styling or arm movements in detail, focusing strictly on footwork.
